questions.stem: Into how many layers are the roughly 37 data modelling techniques categorised?
questions.explanation: The around 37 data modelling techniques are categorised into five layers.

questions.stem: Which of the following is one of the five layers of data modelling techniques?
questions.explanation: Semantic & Information Modelling is one of the five layers alongside Business & Enterprise, Core Data, Specialized Techniques and Governance & AI Extensions.

questions.stem: Which layer of data modelling techniques is named first in the flow?
questions.explanation: Business & Enterprise Modelling is the first of the five layers.

questions.stem: Which layer of data modelling techniques is named last in the flow?
questions.explanation: Governance & AI Extensions is the fifth and final layer.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the five layers of data modelling techniques?
questions.explanation: Physical Storage Modelling is not a layer; the five are Business & Enterprise, Semantic & Information, Core Data, Specialized Techniques and Governance & AI Extensions.

questions.stem: How is Data Modelling characterised within the field of data management and analytics?
options: As an optional add-on for large organisations
As a purely technical database task
As a replacement for business analysis
questions.explanation: Data Modelling is a foundational concept in the field of data management and analytics.

questions.stem: What does Data Modelling involve creating?
options: Different representations of data structures to support business and technical requirements
A single physical database for the whole organisation
Network diagrams of the data centre
questions.explanation: Data Modelling involves creating different representations of data structures to support various business and technical requirements.

questions.stem: Which layer sits between Semantic & Information Modelling and Specialized Techniques in the five-layer flow?
questions.explanation: The order is Business & Enterprise, Semantic & Information, Core Data Modelling, Specialized Techniques, then Governance & AI Extensions.

questions.stem: Which layer directly follows Business & Enterprise Modelling in the five-layer flow?
questions.explanation: Semantic & Information Modelling is the second layer, immediately after Business & Enterprise Modelling.

questions.stem: Which layer is named fourth in the five-layer flow of data modelling techniques?
questions.explanation: Specialized Techniques is the fourth layer, after Core Data Modelling and before Governance & AI Extensions.
